games.name: Mega Escape: Pony Factory
games.desc:
This game contains parkour, story cutscenes, fights with enemies and bosses.
Are you ready to break out of Pony Factory?! Well let's do this!
Overcome All the challenges of the factory.

Also check out our new game - Mega Escape: Dental Clinic.

You can also watch a story based on this game on Youtube channel Cooldad. Watching it might improve your experience with the game.

This game features:
- Engaging parkour
- Various interactions with the environment
- Numerous enemies
- Several types of weapons
- Epic boss fights
- Awesome cutscenes
- Many different buffs and abilities
- Collectible tapes that unlock watching a story in game

games.name: 📒 Brazilian School [RP]
games.desc:
Welcome to 📒 Escola Brasileira [RP], a roleplay game that simulates the experience of a Brazilian school in an immersive and fun way!

🌍 Use the command ";char" and be who you want to be!

🎒 What you can do in the game:
> Meet new colleagues and interact in real time
> Listen to music in the school environment
> Perform activities to earn points
> Conquer school load and evolve in the game
> Participate in realistic roleplay situations
> Play ball with your friends ⚽

🧪 Activities range from answering simple questions, to making portions in the lab!
🏫 Live the day-to-day of a Brazilian school with rooms, social interactions and progression system.

⚠️ Warning: the game is in the launch phase, so bugs and adjustments may occur constantly. We are working to improve the experience continuously.

Enter, explore, evolve and become part of the Brazilian School [RP] community! 🇧🇷✨

games.name: [TITUS]Storm▼ Inc.
games.desc:
Storm inc.
Experience the chaos of the storm like never before! In this immersive tornado game, you can shrink down to a miniature size and face extreme weather up close — or sit back and watch massive storm scenarios unfold from a safe distance.

🔸 Be a Mini Survivor: Dodge flying debris, take shelter, and try to survive as a tiny player in huge tornadoes!
🔸 Be a Storm Watcher: View intense, realistic tornado simulations from different angles and environments.
🔸 Explore unique maps, experience dynamic weather systems, and unlock new perspectives with every supercell!

Can you withstand the fury of nature? Or will you be swept away?

Inspired by Radar Chasers

games.name: Shoot or Die
games.desc:
🔫 SHOOT OR DIE
⚡ 20 Players. 1 Gun. Can you get it first? Dash to the center and grab the weapon! But be careful—in this game, if you miss your shot, you lose!

🔥 BE THE FASTEST: Race your friends to grab the gun. 
🎯 NEVER MISS: You have limited bullets. If you miss, you explode! 
✨ LEVEL UP: Gain Cash to get exclusive gun skins.

🏆 Can you survive the scramble and be the last one standing?

CONTROLS:
DASH - Q / L1
GRAB / SHOOT - Left Click / Tap Screen / R2
LAY DOWN - C/ Button B/Button O
